decision_rule.W1: Must have total P/L > 0 after 40bp total cost AND win_rate >= 65%; recent half-window must not show a clear negative-expectancy breakdown.
decision_rule.V43_X12: Six-month total P/L must be > 0 and remove-best P/L must not turn negative. Extremely small samples may only be retained as PROVISIONAL, never promoted to live authority by this review.
decision_rule.lineage_rule: V43 and X12 share the H20 lineage and their profits must never be added together as independent strategies.

X12.reason: Meets the six-month numerical gates, including remove-best > 0 and both half-windows non-negative, but only three executed operations are available.

V43.reason: Profit is excessively concentrated in one trade; remove-best turns the six-month result negative and win rate is only 50%.

W1_WIDE_TAIL.reason: Fails the locked >=65% win-rate requirement at 40bp and the most recent three-month half-window is negative.

governance.future_research_priority: X12 prospective evidence expansion; do not revive V43 or W1 without a new preregistered challenger/version.
